resources.string: Floating fact checker — tap the side handle for a one-shot screen check (no recording)

FactCheck uses the screen-capture accessibility capability for a single screenshot ONLY when you tap its floating side handle. It never runs a background recording, never reads window content, and never watches your typing.
Stored with device Keystore-backed encryption. Only used for Gemini API calls from this device.

How screen access works: each tap of the floating handle captures ONE screenshot and sends it straight to Gemini. Nothing is recorded in between — no video, no continuous monitoring, no screen content stored on the device.

Screenshots are sent to the selected AI provider (Gemini or Groq) using your API key to produce the fact-check. Live search runs through DuckDuckGo from your device. The app stores nothing and shows verdicts in a small floating panel.
